# JRC Publications Repository

> > Official repository of research publications from the European Commission's Joint Research Centre (JRC), providing evidence-based scientific and technical support for EU policy-making.

The JRC Publications Repository hosts comprehensive studies, frameworks, and reports across digital competence, climate change, industrial competitiveness, and environmental policy. Key outputs include the DigComp framework for digital skills assessment and research on carbon emissions, bioeconomy, and technology impact.

## Key Topics

- DigComp (European Digital Competence Framework)
- Digital skills and competence assessment
- Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
- Greenhouse gas emissions and climate mitigation
- EU Industrial R&D Investment
- Forest bioeconomy and carbon storage
- Digital technology and children
- Energy-intensive industries
- European policy frameworks
- Competitiveness analysis
- Implementation guides and case studies
- Steel industry emissions
- Evidence-based policy support

## Digital Competence and Skills Frameworks

- [DigComp 2.0: European Digital Competence Framework for Citizens](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC101254): DigComp 2.0: European Digital Competence Framework for Citizens
- [DigComp Implementation Guide](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC110624): DigComp implementation guide with case studies and user guidance
- [Young Children and Digital Technology Study](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC110359): Cross-national study on young children (0-8) and digital technology

## Climate Change and Environmental Policy

- [Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Emission Intensities](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC134682): Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) emission intensities study
- [Forest Bioeconomy and Climate Change Mitigation](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC124374): Forest bioeconomy and climate change mitigation carbon storage study

## Industrial Competitiveness and R&D

- [EU Industrial R&D Investment Scoreboard](https://publications.jrc.ec.europa.eu/repository/handle/JRC144638): EU Industrial R&D Investment Scoreboard for competitiveness analysis
